features.name: Aphrodite's Love and Zeus's Thunder
features.description: Hearts restore Vitality to all wilds, and the X symbol doubles every wild multiplier.

features.name: FS Collect
features.description: 3–4 FS symbols trigger a bonus, and single FS symbols can be banked in a meter during respins.

review:
Greek gods on a 5x4, 14-line grid. Wild multipliers range from 2x to 200x and add together in a win, and wilds can land with up to three Vitality hearts – while they have hearts, they stick and give respins, losing one each time.

Heart symbols top them back up, and the X symbol doubles every wild multiplier on screen. Three or four FS symbols trigger the bonuses. Rated 3/5 with a 10,000x max. Great if you like sticky-wild respin chains.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
